result: The patient chart uses `UserIcon` in two places, both as a small "orderer information" icon inside a tooltip. Both are in `openmrs-esm-patient-chart`, and both get the icon through `@openmrs/esm-framework`. **Confirmed consumers (in the chart)** 1. `packages/esm-patient-orders-app/src/components/medication-record.component.tsx`, `InfoTooltip` (lines 105–117). It imports `UserIcon` from `@openmrs/esm-framework` (line 5) and renders `` inside a `ToggletipButton` (line 110). The button is wrapped by `Toggletip`, so any change to how the icon renders, sizes, or forwards refs would reach this tooltip trigger. 2. `packages/esm-patient-medications-app/src/components/medications-details-table.component.tsx`, `InfoTooltip` (lines 376–382). `UserIcon` is in the framework import list (line 48) and rendered as `` inside an `IconButton` (line 379). Only `size` is passed here, so a change to the default size, the rendered SVG, or the `omrs-icon-user` glyph would show up in this table. **Definition that would change (in `openmrs-esm-core`)** - `packages/framework/esm-styleguide/src/icons/icons.tsx`, lines 824–828. This is the real implementation: `memo(forwardRef(...))` around ``. I analysed this one. `UserIcon` is also exported from the styleguide and the framework, so a change here propagates to the chart through `@openmrs/esm-framework`. **Test mocks and docs (in `openmrs-esm-core`, not runtime code)** - `packages/framework/esm-styleguide/mock.tsx`, line 99. Stub `UserIcon = () => UserIcon`. Any chart tests that mock the framework would get this stub, not the real icon. The chart grep found no test files that reference `UserIcon`. - `packages/framework/esm-styleguide/mock-jest.tsx`, line 98. Same stub for Jest. - `packages/framework/esm-framework/docs/variables/UserIcon.md`, line 3. Generated API doc. It would only need updating if the type changed (it is a `MemoExoticComponent` of `ForwardRefExoticComponent`). **Not verified** - I did not read the `@openmrs/esm-framework` re-export file, so the link from the framework to the styleguide is inferred from the docs path and the chart import, not from reading the re-export line. - A behaviour change that affects ref forwarding could matter inside `ToggletipButton` and `IconButton`, which may clone or ref their children. I did not read those components, so that impact is likely but unconfirmed. - Other openmrs-esm repositories (billing, patient-management, form-engine and so on) may also use `UserIcon`.
